title: Does this annoy you too?
html:
Driving long distances gives us an insight into the psyche of people. Everyday you can see who is going somewhere, and who is drifting, right here on our roads.

Over the weekend I noticed two examples of drifting and I thought about them more, to find out why they annoy me. The actions were; people pulling out into the fast lane in front of me and people speeding up on passing lanes.

The questions that came to mind were, "Are these people on autopilot?" and, "Did they see me?"

My answers were probably ‘yes’ to the first question and ‘no’ to the second and I also noticed these people were oblivious to the effect they had on the people around them.

How does their driving relate to your life?

When you know what you want the path is clear. However, there are always people or events that drift into your path and hold you up. Or there are people who speed up as you pass them because they don't want to be left behind but who, inevitably will be because they don’t know how to go around corners.

These people and events are sent to test us and if you don't handle them correctly, like on the road, you will end up with a ticket.
